intentions: Manage customer data including creation, retrieval, and updates
Maintain product information with attributes like name, price, and stock levels
Track stock levels and support stock updates and restocking
Process orders with support for order creation, status tracking, and cancellation
Handle order lines with product references, quantities, and pricing
Apply discounts and taxes to orders during calculation
Support order cancellation with proper state updates and stock restoration
Restore stock levels after order cancellation
Generate reports on orders, sales, stock, and customer activity
Export order and inventory data to CSV format for external use
Split the application into modular components for maintainability and scalability
Ensure clean separation of concerns between data models, business logic, and presentation
